aviation_incidents.headline: 飛安彙整：易捷航空班機遭鳥擊安全返航 美鷹航空班機前起落架異常指示後安全降落 IndiGo班機中斷起飛後返回停機坪 美國航空機組關閉發動機後轉降奧蘭多
aviation_incidents.summary: 2026年11月18日，易捷航空U2-213遭鳥擊後安全返航布里斯托。2026年11月17日，美鷹航空AA-5206進場時出現前起落架不安全指示，塔台確認起落架放下，飛機安全降落，美國聯邦航空總署正調查。2026年11月16日，IndiGo 6E-388起飛滑跑時左發動機傳巨響並噴火，機組高速中斷起飛並安全返回停機坪；美國航空AA-496左發動機指示異常，機組關閉發動機後安全轉降奧蘭多。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Safety roundup: easyJet returns after bird strike, American Eagle lands after gear warning, IndiGo aborts takeoff, American Airlines diverts to Orlando
aviation_incidents.summary_en: On November 18, 2026, easyJet flight U2-213 returned safely to Bristol after a bird strike. On November 17, 2026, American Eagle flight AA-5206 reported an unsafe nose-gear indication. The tower confirmed the gear was down, and the aircraft landed safely; the FAA is investigating. On November 16, 2026, IndiGo flight 6E-388 rejected takeoff at high speed after bangs and flames came from its left engine; it stopped safely and returned to the apron. That day, the crew of American Airlines flight AA-496 shut down the left engine after an abnormal indication and diverted safely to Orlando.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局為選舉協調增加離島航線2,444座位 11月20日開放訂位
taiwan_aviation.summary: 民航局為因應11月28日地方選舉返鄉需求，協調航空公司新增20架次離島航線運能，含改用較大機型，共提供2,444個座位。11月20日上午9時開放訂位；若訂不到首選班次，可考慮其他日期或離峰時段。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan regulator adds 2,444 offshore flight seats for elections, bookings open November 20
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: To meet demand for travel home for the November 28 local elections, Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration coordinated with airlines to add capacity across 20 offshore-island flight movements, including upgrades to larger aircraft, providing 2,444 seats. Bookings open at 9 a.m. on November 20; passengers unable to book their preferred flights can consider other dates or off-peak times.

sources.name: 交通部民用航空局 CAA Taiwan

taiwan_aviation.headline: 國防部偵獲1架次共機越海峽中線 進入臺灣西南防空識別區
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部表示，11月18日上午6時至19日上午6時，在臺灣周邊偵獲1架次共機，該機越過臺灣海峽中線並進入臺灣西南防空識別區；前一日同時段偵獲9架次。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan defense ministry reports one PLA aircraft crossing median line into southwestern ADIZ
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defense detected one PLA aircraft sortie around Taiwan between 6 a.m. on November 18 and 6 a.m. on November 19. The aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered Taiwan’s southwestern air defense identification zone. The previous daily report recorded nine aircraft sorties.

international_aviation.headline: Textron簽約擬以12億美元出售工業事業 聚焦航太與國防
international_aviation.summary: Textron於11月18日宣布，已簽約以12億美元將Kautex與Textron Specialized Vehicles出售給Kingswood Capital Management關係企業，預計扣除稅費及交易成本後取得約11億美元現金。交易預計2027年上半年交割，須取得監管核准並滿足其他條件。Textron將保留旗下包含塞斯納與比奇的Textron Aviation、貝爾直升機及Textron Systems，聚焦航太與國防。
international_aviation.headline_en: Textron agrees to sell industrial units for $1.2 billion and focus on aerospace and defense
international_aviation.summary_en: On November 18, Textron announced a $1.2 billion agreement to sell Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles to a Kingswood Capital Management affiliate. It expects about $1.1 billion in cash after taxes and transaction expenses. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval and other conditions. Textron will retain Textron Aviation, including Cessna and Beechcraft, as well as Bell and Textron Systems, and focus on aerospace and defense.

international_aviation.headline: 加拿大航空將於12月13日開航溫哥華至哥斯大黎加利比里亞 將成旗下最長737 MAX航線
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大航空將於12月13日開航溫哥華至哥斯大黎加利比里亞，全長5,512公里，成為該公司最長的737 MAX航線。航班由Rouge以177座737 MAX 8執飛，每週兩班、部分期間三班，營運至2027年4月12日。Rouge機隊計畫從2025年底的33架增至52架，並全數換為737 MAX，座位總數增加約70%。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada to launch its longest 737 MAX route from Vancouver to Liberia, Costa Rica
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada will launch its 5,512-kilometer Vancouver–Liberia, Costa Rica, route on December 13, making it the airline’s longest 737 MAX route. Rouge will operate a 177-seat 737 MAX 8 twice weekly through April 12, 2027, with three weekly services during selected periods. Rouge plans to grow from 33 aircraft at the end of 2025 to an all-MAX fleet of 52, increasing seats by about 70%.

international_aviation.headline: 航空短訊：2028年法恩伯勒航展預訂率達93% NTSB發現阻燃劑腐蝕滅火飛機 籲美國林務局強化測試
international_aviation.summary: 2028年法恩伯勒航展預訂率已達93%，主辦方增加展覽空間。NTSB調查發現阻燃劑腐蝕滅火飛機，呼籲美國林務局強化測試。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aviation briefs: Farnborough 2028 is 93% booked, NTSB finds retardant corrosion on firefighting aircraft and urges testing
international_aviation.summary_en: The 2028 Farnborough Airshow is 93% booked, and organizers have added exhibition space. Separately, the NTSB found that fire retardant corroded firefighting aircraft and urged the US Forest Service to strengthen testing.

international_aviation.headline: 航空短訊：AeroForce X完成有人駕駛首飛 漢莎航空機師工會要求11月23日前重新考慮調解人方案 美國航空A321neo機隊達90架
international_aviation.summary: Aerodata的AeroForce X原型偵察機完成有人駕駛首飛，目標續航40小時，無人飛行測試時程未定。漢莎航空提出在2033年底前最多增聘1,000名機師的方案；工會批評其拒絕調解人方案，要求11月23日前重新考慮。美國航空A321neo機隊達90架，預計年底前再接收3架A321家族飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aviation briefs: AeroForce X completes piloted first flight, Lufthansa pilots’ union sets November 23 deadline, American Airlines’ A321neo fleet reaches 90
international_aviation.summary_en: Aerodata’s AeroForce X reconnaissance prototype completed its maiden flight with a pilot aboard. It targets up to 40 hours of endurance, with no unmanned flight test date announced. Lufthansa has offered to hire up to 1,000 pilots by the end of 2033; its pilots’ union says the airline rejected the mediator’s proposal and wants it reconsidered before November 23. American Airlines’ A321neo fleet has reached 90, and it expects three more A321-family aircraft by year-end.
